notes.title: Demo 2 Now Available
notes.content:
[p]This demo focuses on a defense and base-building playstyle. You can build your base, gather resources, manage your economy, building towers and buy units to protect your base.

[/p][previewyoutube="waPny0BWt4E;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]The new demo now includes a tutorial to help you understand the game more easily. You can learn how to build your base, gather resources, and defend against enemies step by step.[/p][p][/p][p]The old melee mode with bots has been removed. It was not very fun and did not have much strategy. That mode was better for multiplayer, but this game is made by one person, so it was too much.[/p][p][/p][p]In the full version, there will be many [b]campaigns[/b] with different challenges for players to enjoy.[/p][p][/p][p]Visit the homepage and download the new demo to try it out.[/p][p]
Let me know what you think – I’d love to hear your feedback![/p]

notes.title: Let's try the new Defense Mode
notes.content:
Hey friend, 

After more than 2 months of work, I have completed the gameplay for the new defense mode. This is the main mode of Flow of War besides skirmish mode.

In this game mode, you will harvest resources and build and defend against enemy attacks with walls, towers and troops.

notes.title: Demo Small Update v0.3.4.2
notes.content:
[h2][b]Updated:[/b][/h2]

- Workers will avoid combat and try to survive longer.
- Barrack can choose anywhere on the map to attack.
- Tiny Map mode is a bit wider to make it easier for you to play.
- More goldmines and more woods.
- Walls are cheaper so you can build more.

[h2][b]Note :[/b][/h2]

- You can use the Shift key to build multiple buildings at the same time.

[h2][b]Next plan :[/b][/h2]

I'm also planning to develop [b]a massive and interesting campaigns[/b]. It will follow the roquelike/roquelites trend but still retain its main identity as RTS

After letting many people try it, I found that the game modes are not really that attractive, so I will reduce the game modes and spend more time on the Campaign part.

I received a lot of valuable feedback and will slowly update.

You can follow the dev process here:
[url=https://twitter.com/RongconGames]https://twitter.com/RongconGames[/url]

notes.title: Demo now available!
notes.content:
I'm happy to release the demo of Flow of War. This demo will be kept and updated with more features.

[h2]Demo content[/h2]

With the[b] Standard[/b] default game mode, you will experience a completely new auto-micro gameplay by minimizing troop control activities, you will play more simply and focus on many other aspects.

In addition to the standard game mode, there will be two more experimental modes: Tiny Map and Fast autowar.

[b]Tiny Map[/b]: gameplay is similar to standard, however players will start on an extremely small map and have to fight continuously. With limited resources, plus constant threats from opponents, players need to calculate accurately to survive.

[b]Fast Autowar[/b]: changed quite a lot compared to standard, the soldiers will attack completely automatically. You must ensure both exploitation and expansion and bring troops to fight to limit the opponent's expansion.

[h2]Feedback[/h2]
I hope to receive a lot of feedback from you, please post it in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2637210/discussions/]the community of this game[/url]

[h2]Demo FAQ[/h2]

[b]What features are available in the demo?[/b]
- Currently the demo only includes 20-30% of the total content for the official game. So if you enjoyed the demo, you will definitely love the official game.

- Although it only covers 20-30%, the demo is built with high polish and very few errors.

[b]Do you have a roadmap?[/b]
- Roadmap as well as game guide will be updated on our website. If you want to receive updates, please subscribe to [url=https://mailchi.mp/ef6e9c9a5840/rongcon-gamess-update]our mailling list[/url]. 

Thank you for reading, if you have any questions, please drop below!
